description: TPC-DS is the decision-support benchmark of the Transaction Processing Performance Council. It models a retailer that sells through three channels: physical stores, a mail-order catalog and a web site. Each channel has a sales table and a returns table, and one more fact table tracks inventory. Dimension tables describe dates, times, items, customers, stores and the other things a sale refers to. Every fact row is one line item of a sale (or return); line items of one order share a ticket number (store) or order number (catalog, web). Keys ending in _sk are surrogate keys that join facts to dimensions.
label: tpcds
name: tpcds
